memory_candidates.content: When a hard-blocking gate (e.g. a completion-deploy freshness check) composes with a separate churn/loop-detection guard, a task the gate legitimately refuses will deterministically re-derive identical inputs on retry -- the guard must not charge that re-derivation against its own counter. Resolve by (1) a structural fix that converges the task before the guard's input is re-derived at all (e.g. an automatic reconcile/promotion pass at the one point with no dispatch in flight), and (2) a narrow backstop that FREEZES (never suppresses) the guard's counter specifically when the gate's own transient marker is present, scoped to that one task's own marker rather than any batch-wide signal. This preserves the guard's full strength for genuine non-convergence while removing the false-positive interaction.

A transient marker set by a refusal path (e.g. deploy_pending: true on exit 6) must be cleared at the SAME single chokepoint that later performs the successful transition it was recording -- never left to a separate cleanup pass. Locate the one script/function every caller of that transition already funnels through (verified by tracing every caller, not assumed), and clear the marker there, immediately after the write succeeds, never on a refusal. An uncleared transient marker silently arms any downstream logic that reads it (e.g. a streak-freeze backstop) permanently, long after the condition it recorded has resolved.

To empirically prove a new regression test arm actually pins a fix (rather than passing vacuously before and after), swap the SUT file to its pre-fix git commit content via a plain filesystem copy (git show <commit>:<path> > tmp; cp tmp <path>) rather than `git checkout -- <path>` when the working tree has unrelated uncommitted changes elsewhere -- the destructive-git guard hook blocks `git checkout --` on any dirty tree, even for a clean file, but a plain `cp` swap is unaffected. Re-run the suite, confirm the target arms go RED, then restore the post-fix content via the same cp mechanism and confirm `git diff --stat` shows zero diff.
